subject: Confirmed source/model race: normal Alpha3 opening progression can invalidate queued WakeInner
body: SOURCE+MODEL CONFIRMED: ordered ingress can replay an opening threshold sample followed by an >=8° sample in one main-thread drain. The first emits WakeInner(G); the second legitimately transitions OPENING_FROM_CLOSED→INNER_HANDOFF and increments generation to G+1. Fold7ContinuityCoordinator's asynchronously started IO wake re-checks isGenerationCurrent(G) and can therefore return without calling wakeInnerDisplay(). Kotlin schedule model reproduces wakeCalls=0 for 3.2→8.2 and 15→15.5 when IO is delayed. Negative result: deleting the re-check makes reversal stale-wake unsafe. Gen2 direction: semantic opening-attempt/wake-intent token lasting across normal handoff, revoked by reversal/reset/privilege loss/destroy/new attempt/confirmed inner-active; atomic one-shot start commit. No device occurrence claimed.
